_doc: Cau hinh P3 cho myArm M750. Sua o day, khong sua trong code.

servo._doc: J nap tu configs/servo_jacobian.json. max_step_z_m = 20mm vi gripper cao hon vat ~220mm, phai cho ha that chu khong ri ra.

safety._z_floor_doc: 0.24 m = ngang dinh khoi xanh (nguoi dung xac nhan). Mat tham ~0.18 m, khoi xanh cao ~50 mm. Dau ngon kep thoa xuong duoi TCP ~20-40 mm nen muc nay giu dau ngon cach mat tham.

gripper._doc: Do mo khi tien lai de gap, met (0 = ngam het co).

runner._doc: max_age_s PHAI lon hon tong do tre hai lan goi model (~30s), neu khong runner nem TimeoutError sau predict(). Xem runner.py dong 180.
